notes: v5.2.6 Hardened separates repository policy (maximum scope) from explicit external authorization grants issued through /ade-authorize; OpenCode ask remains an additional permission channel, not proof of human presence.

High-impact grants are project-scoped, single-use, short-lived and bound to the exact resolved effect: remote target/config, full payload digest and relevant VCS/check state. Stale effects are blocked before the side effect.

The grant store is outside .ai, inaccessible to agents through ADE permission boundaries, and corruption/oversize fail closed. Provenance is EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL_GRANT, not a cryptographic claim of physical user presence.
Behavioral/live model tests remain separate from install/migrate; Windows/provider revalidation is explicit after restart.

Final hardening also rejects grant stores located inside/overlapping the project or resolving through symlink/junction parents, preventing environment-based collapse of the external authorization channel.
